description: Resize / convert an image (GD): width/height up to 4096, fit contain|cover|fill|inside, output png|jpeg|webp|gif, quality, EXIF auto-orient, metadata stripped. Body: { "image": "<base64>", "width": 256 }. Max ~190KB input image (the service caps POST bodies at 256KB, base64 included). Price: $0.01 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/image-resize

background.description: Hex colour used when flattening alpha to JPEG

image.description: Base64 / data URI image (max ~190KB decoded due to the 256KB POST body limit; max 40 MP source)
